summary: Mr. Sutton discusses Lag BaOmer, exploring the figures of Rebbe Shimon bar Yochai and Bar Kokhba, the history of the holiday, and the significance of the carob tree. He examines the two approaches of the soldier and the scholar in Jewish history.
questions: What is the history behind Lag BaOmer?
Why is Rebbe Shimon bar Yochai associated with carobs?
How does the Midrash connect carobs to the book of Yeshayahu?
What are the two different approaches represented on Lag BaOmer?
